record.question: Which one of the following lakes in India has the highest water salinity?
record.explanation: Answer D: Sambhar. Sambhar is India’s largest inland salt lake and the best answer among the listed lakes. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/place/Sambhar-Salt-Lake. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date..
